command:
cat > /tmp/normalize-text-exports.py <<'ANTRIEB_NORMALIZE_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import stat
import sys
from pathlib import Path

base = Path("/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization")
manifest = base / "encodings.tsv"
incoming = base / "incoming"
normalized = base / "normalized"
normalized.mkdir(mode=0o755, exist_ok=True)

errors = []
published = []
lines = manifest.read_text(encoding="ascii").splitlines()
for line_number, line in enumerate(lines[1:], 2):
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    parts = line.split()
    if len(parts) != 2:
        errors.append(f"manifest line {line_number}: expected filename and encoding")
        continue
    filename, encoding = parts
    if Path(filename).name != filename:
        errors.append(f"manifest line {line_number}: unsafe filename {filename!r}")
        continue
    source = incoming / filename
    destination = normalized / filename
    temporary = normalized / f".{filename}.tmp"
    try:
        data = source.read_bytes()
        text = data.decode(encoding, errors="strict")
        output = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").encode("utf-8")
        fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, stat.S_IMODE(source.stat().st_mode))
        try:
            with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
                stream.write(output)
                stream.flush()
                os.fsync(stream.fileno())
            os.replace(temporary, destination)
            published.append(filename)
        except BaseException:
            try:
                os.unlink(temporary)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            raise
    except (UnicodeError, LookupError) as exc:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        errors.append(f"{filename}: undecodable as {encoding}: {exc}")
    except OSError as exc:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        errors.append(f"{filename}: I/O failure: {exc}")

for filename in published:
    print(f"PUBLISHED {filename}")
for error in errors:
    print(f"ERROR {error}", file=sys.stderr)
sys.exit(1 if errors else 0)
ANTRIEB_NORMALIZE_EOF
chmod 700 /tmp/normalize-text-exports.py
/tmp/normalize-text-exports.py
rc=$?
rm -f /tmp/normalize-text-exports.py
exit "$rc"

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
base = Path("/srv/legacy2/text-export-normalization")
expected_names = set()
for line in (base / "encodings.tsv").read_text("ascii").splitlines()[1:]:
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    name, encoding = line.split()
    src = (base / "incoming" / name).read_bytes()
    dst = base / "normalized" / name
    try:
        text = src.decode(encoding, "strict")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        assert not dst.exists()
        print(f"POST_RESTART_REJECTED {name} offset={exc.start} destination_absent=yes")
        continue
    expected = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").encode("utf-8")
    actual = dst.read_bytes()
    actual.decode("utf-8", "strict")
    assert actual == expected
    assert b"\r" not in actual
    assert text.endswith(("\r", "\n")) == actual.endswith(b"\n")
    expected_names.add(name)
    empty_records = sum(1 for record in actual.split(b"\n")[:-1] if record == b"")
    print(f"POST_RESTART_VERIFIED {name} utf8=yes lf_only=yes empty_records={empty_records} final_newline={'yes' if actual.endswith(bytes([10])) else 'no'}")
actual_names = {p.name for p in (base / "normalized").iterdir() if p.is_file()}
assert actual_names == expected_names, (actual_names, expected_names)
print("POST_RESTART_OUTPUT_SET PASS", ",".join(sorted(actual_names)))
PY
printf 'PERMISSIONS\n'; stat -c '%A %U:%G %a %n' "$base/incoming" "$base/encodings.tsv" "$base/normalized" "$base/normalized"/*
